stat.rttTip: Carrier round-trip (control-stream ping/pong). Session-scoped: all tunnels under one agent share this curve. Includes retransmits and peer scheduling delay, so it reads higher than link RTT

live.mtuTip: Learned reactively. Before PMTUD completes it sits low (~1244 B); without showing it, nobody can explain why large packets fail while small ones work.

udpDrops.title: UDP staged drops (60s)
udpDrops.hint: "We dropped" is useless; "we dropped at the carrier inflight cap" tells you which knob to turn.

sessions.title: Sessions ({{count}})
sessions.sinceOpen: Only sessions observed since this page opened — a Session is observed state, and its absence never implies the Tunnel was deleted.

passthrough.notice: In passthrough the relay does not parse the application layer, so there are no status-code or path metrics. Available: connections, bytes, RTT.
passthrough.clientIP: In passthrough the client IP the backend sees really is unknown — only PROXY protocol restores it. Shown honestly rather than quietly faked.

switchDialog.title: Switch to gateway mode
switchDialog.intro: This switch moves the trust boundary. Confirm each point:
switchDialog.item1: The relay starts issuing a certificate for the domain (ACME), with a short validation burst.
switchDialog.item2: The TLS private key moves to the relay, so the relay can see plaintext.
switchDialog.item3: These headers get injected: X-Forwarded-For, X-Forwarded-Proto, X-Real-IP.
switchDialog.item4: The entry can now share 443 with other tunnels, changing port exclusivity.

history.retention: Retention: 1-minute buckets for 48 h, 5-minute for 30 d, 1-hour for 400 d.

learn.title: Learn mode
learn.intro: Pin the sources the relay has actually observed into an allow-list to narrow this tunnel's exposure. Check the ones to keep; the rest are left alone.
learn.volatile: Observations live in memory only and are cleared on relay restart — these are third-party addresses and are never persisted.
learn.empty: No sources observed yet. Addresses will appear here once clients connect.
learn.unsupported: This relay build does not observe source addresses.
learn.hint: An address with few hits that showed up only once is most likely a scanner, not your client — during the learning window the relay cannot tell them apart.
learn.truncated: This list is incomplete: the observation cap was reached (most likely filled by a port scan). Narrowing from it would lock out every real client that did not make the list.
learn.already: This tunnel already has an allow-list; checked sources are merged in, existing ranges are not replaced.
learn.open: This tunnel currently accepts any source (an empty allow_cidrs means allow everything).
learn.declined: Your choice is recorded; no further prompts.
learn.confirmBody: Only the {{count}} prefixes below will reach this tunnel; everything else is refused. Clients that have not shown up yet will be locked out and you will have to add their ranges by hand.
learn.nothingNew: Every checked source is already in the allow-list; nothing to add.
learn.nothingSelected: Check at least one — an empty allow-list means allow everything, which is not narrowing.
